inputs.modified_text:
Look at the absolute disaster unfolding in the South Portland School District. We are watching a total failure of basic stewardship as they face a massive budget shortfall that is forcing them to slash more than 70 positions from our schools. Once again, our children and our hard-earned tax dollars are paying the price for this reckless incompetence.

As one local parent and taxpayer rightly put it, it is beyond maddening. For years, we’ve watched bloated bureaucracies and progressive mismanagement prioritize everything except the fundamentals—teaching the basics, respecting parents, and maintaining fiscal sanity. When the people running these institutions can't even balance a budget, they are failing the most basic test of authority and responsibility. 

Instead of focusing on core education and traditional values that build strong communities, these systems are crumbling under their own weight, leaving families to pick up the pieces. If we don't demand accountability and return to local, sensible stewardship, our children's future will continue to be sacrificed on the altar of administrative waste.
